name: Swearing Profane
overview: Scripture solemnly commands that God's name must never be taken in vain, warning that the Lord will not hold guiltless those who profane His name, as emphasized in Exodus 20:7 and Deuteronomy 5:11. The seriousness of this offense is further illustrated in Leviticus 24, where blasphemy against the Lord's name, even by the son of an Israelitish woman, brought immediate and severe punishment, including death by stoning as commanded to Moses. The example of Gehazi in 2 Kings 5:20 also highlights the gravity of swearing by the Lord's name improperly, showing the heart attitude behind such profane speech. These passages collectively affirm that swearing profanely is a desecration of God's holiness, deserving both divine judgment and the believer's careful avoidance.
